title: Tending the Flames
description: Help the Bards College save the Burning of King Olaf festival by retrieving King Olaf's Verse from Dead Men's Respite, improvising missing parts for the Jarl's court, and preparing the festival effigy.

base_facts: I am the Headmaster of the Bards College in Solitude.
The Burning of King Olaf festival has been canceled by Jarl Elisif the Fair due to High King Torygg's death.
I need King Olaf's Verse from the Poetic Edda to convince the Jarl to allow the festival.

FIND_VERSE: The player has agreed to retrieve King Olaf's Verse from Dead Men's Respite.
RETURN_AND_RECONSTRUCT: The player returned with the Verse but parts are decayed. We must improvise the missing sections to save the festival.
COURT_PERFORMANCE: The court accepted our performance of King Olaf's Verse. The player should speak to me about joining the College.
COMPLETION: The Burning of King Olaf festival has been successfully restored and held in Solitude.
The player has been formally inducted into the Bards College as a new member.
Viarmo rewarded the player with leveled gold for their service to the College.
Viarmo's disposition toward the player has increased for saving the festival.

base_facts: I am preparing the effigy of King Olaf for the Burning of King Olaf festival at the Bards College.

FESTIVAL_PREP: I need General Tullius' coat to finish the effigy. The player must steal it for me.
FESTIVAL: The player brought the coat. The effigy is ready and the festival can begin after dusk.
COMPLETION: The effigy of King Olaf was successfully burned at the festival.
Jorn's disposition toward the player has increased for helping complete the effigy and restore the festival.

base_facts: I am the Dean of History at the Bards College.
I believe King Olaf's Verse can be found in Dead Men's Respite, which may also be King Olaf's burial tomb.

COMPLETION: Giraud's disposition toward the player has increased following the festival's success.
The player's retrieval of King Olaf's Verse from Dead Men's Respite vindicated Giraud's theory about the tomb.

beats.comment: Player accepts the task to find King Olaf's Verse at Dead Men's Respite.
Player returns with the Verse and helps Viarmo reconstruct the decayed parts through improvisation.
Player attends Viarmo's performance at the Blue Palace and speaks to him after the court accepts the Verse.
Player speaks to Jorn and must steal General Tullius' coat for the effigy.
Player places the coat on the effigy and attends the Burning of King Olaf.
Player is inducted into the Bards College after the festival.
